minor.issue: Still a fully synchronous request that runs FFmpeg audio extract + Whisper + GPT-5.6-terra + Emergent Object Storage. issues: 'Unlimited tests' wraps to two lines in the desktop header on 1920x1080 while there is spare width. Cosmetic only; wraps because the label uses fixed layout. Consider white-space:nowrap on the unlimited state.

AuthScreen has both authentication-mode-switch-button and email-authentication-* test ids while EditorHeader uses usage-credit-count/usage-meter-button - consistent enough; document these ids in a testing README for stability.
